question: Sudip Roy Barman became Member of Legislative Assembly from ____________ constituency in June 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agartala.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Sudip Roy Barman became a Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) in June 2022.**
 
• **He was elected from the Agartala constituency.**
 
• Agartala is the capital city of the Indian state of Tripura.
 
• Sudip Roy Barman is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and was previously a Minister of Education in the Tripura Government.
 
• Mysore is a city in the Indian state of Karnataka and does not have any connection with Sudip Roy Barman or his political career.
 
• Bilaspur is a city in the Indian state of Chhattisgarh and does not have any connection with Sudip Roy Barman or his political career.
 
• Hajipur is a city in the Indian state of Bihar and does not have any connection with Sudip Roy Barman or his political career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/292e0c96dd6c006ce1f3ef21b86308c7c73a2bc69f508d641b46f352d114f429.png] Important Points__

 
• A Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) is a representative, elected by the voters of an electoral district (constituency) to the legislature of the State government in the Indian system of government.
 
• From each constituency, the people elect one representative who then becomes a member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA). 
 
• Each state is divided into a specific number of Assembly constituencies.
 
• In this case, the elected representative is called the Member of Legislative Assembly or an MLA.
 
• Each Parliamentary constituency has several assembly constituencies.
